Name: Luny's Cozy Simple Shawl for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sHoUQXE.png[/img]﻿
Adds a cute shawl to fashion sense with two shirt options underneath. The Shawl + Apron Dress version was made to match with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23925]farm dresses[/url], so you can just throw a shawl over the dress for colder seasons. The Shawl + Shirt has the shawl overtop a basic shirt, so it can be mixed with most other clothes. Both shawl variations use the same sleeves, but since the sleeves are their own FS item they can also be paired with any other top.

Fashion Sense items included in this mod:
Shawl + Apron Dress
Shawl + Shirt
Shawl Sleeves



[img]https://i.imgur.com/lTKkn3N.png[/img]

[center]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ to work! Install that first if you don't already have it.
Download and unzip the mod file.
Move the folder "[FS] Luny's Cozy Simple Shawl" to your StardewValley/mods folder.
Done! The clothes can now be accessed via Fashion Sense's hand mirror item.
